note: Two fresh instantiations per pattern, in domains other than trading. copied_runs counts shared runs of eight or more consecutive content words against the source spans; all zero.

patterns.function: 先铺一个大场面，再落到读者想知道的事
examples: City bus routes keep getting longer, yet riders still cannot tell whether the next coach will arrive on time, which is what every commuter wants settled.
Hospital wards fill up each winter, but families cannot tell which ward has a free bed tonight, which is what every relative asks first.
patterns.appropriate: Opening a piece whose reader has a concrete unanswered question.
patterns.forbidden: Putting a measured result inside the scene sentence.

patterns.function: 成对的数把整句再说一遍，用 while 接
patterns.order: metric of A > value > while > metric of B > value
examples: The north line reaches a delay of 4 minutes while the south line reaches a delay of 11 minutes.
The morning shift reaches a defect count of 3 while the evening shift reaches a defect count of 9.
patterns.appropriate: Reporting the same metric for two peers where the repetition itself signals the comparison.
patterns.forbidden: Using it when the two halves measure different things.

patterns.function: 先给终值，再用一句话换成倍数
patterns.order: terminal value > date > multiple of initial
examples: The fund stood at 2,400 by March. That is roughly double the sum first deposited.
The tank held 900 litres by June. That is close to three times the volume it held in January.
patterns.appropriate: When a raw total needs a plain-language scale for a non-specialist reader.
patterns.forbidden: Letting the multiple sentence contradict the total it translates.

patterns.function: 两个对象用一个分号连成平行句，方向相反
patterns.order: when A rises > effect > semicolon > when B rises > opposite effect
examples: When the fare rises, ridership holds steady; when the headway rises, ridership falls sharply.
When the dose rises, recovery stays flat; when the delay rises, recovery slows.
patterns.appropriate: Two factors tested the same way that push the outcome in opposite directions.
patterns.forbidden: Joining two factors that were not tested on the same outcome.

patterns.function: Therefore 指向刚才那对平行句里更敏感的一个
patterns.order: paired evidence > therefore > the more sensitive one
examples: Therefore the timetable is more sensitive to headway than to fare.
Therefore the crop is more sensitive to watering than to shading.
patterns.appropriate: Immediately after a paired sentence whose halves point opposite ways.
patterns.forbidden: Opening a section with Therefore before the reader has seen the pair.

patterns.function: 用一句引出一份清单，每条一个交付
patterns.order: goal > we need to > bullet > bullet
examples: To meet the deadline, the crew needs to: survey the route, order the timber, and book the crane.
To open the ward, the staff needs to: hire nurses, fit the beds, and stock the pharmacy.
patterns.appropriate: A work plan whose items later appear as sections in the same order.
patterns.forbidden: Listing a step the rest of the piece never returns to.

patterns.function: 一次只动一个量，另一个保持不变，交替做
patterns.order: change one > hold the other > alternate
examples: The test raises the oven temperature while holding the baking time fixed, then raises the baking time while holding the temperature fixed.
The trial lengthens the lesson while holding class size fixed, then grows the class while holding the lesson fixed.
patterns.appropriate: A sensitivity check where two factors could be confused with each other.
patterns.forbidden: Moving both factors in the same run and still calling it one-at-a-time.

patterns.function: 假设写在子弹上，迫使它成立的理由缩进在下一行
patterns.order: assumption > indented reason naming the constraint
examples: Deliveries arrive only on weekdays. The depot shuts on Saturday, so no weekend slot exists.
Seeds are treated as disease free. The supplier certificate covers the batch, so no separate test is run.
patterns.appropriate: An assumption the reader would otherwise challenge, where the constraint is nameable.
patterns.forbidden: Indenting a reason that only restates the assumption in different words.

patterns.function: 先报现象，再用 The reason may be that 给原因
patterns.order: phenomenon > the reason may be that > cause
examples: Queues grew after noon. The reason may be that the second counter closes at lunch.
Seedlings wilted on the west row. The reason may be that the west row gets the afternoon sun.
patterns.appropriate: A cause the data suggests but does not prove.
patterns.forbidden: Using may be for a cause the same table already confirms.

patterns.function: 几种情形共用三句，只换符号模式
patterns.order: noted as > substituted as > built as
examples: The weekday case is noted as a full shift, substituted with the eight-hour rate, and built into the payroll total.
The holiday case is noted as a half shift, substituted with the double rate, and built into the payroll total.
patterns.appropriate: Several cases that differ in one slot and share every other sentence.
patterns.forbidden: Reusing the frame for a case that drops or adds a step.

patterns.function: 建议用祈使句，理由跟在逗号或 since 后面
examples: Book the crane early, since the yard releases it only a week ahead.
Label every sample, since unlabeled tubes are discarded at intake.
patterns.appropriate: A recommendation addressed to a specific reader who must act.
patterns.forbidden: An imperative whose reason the reader has not been shown.

patterns.function: 末段先承认只覆盖什么，再提出可以扩展的方向
patterns.order: operate only on > can be further extended
examples: The count covers only weekday trips and only two routes. It can be extended to weekends and to the remaining routes.
The check covers only one ward and only morning rounds. It can be extended to the other wards and to evening rounds.
patterns.appropriate: Closing a memo or letter whose reader might assume a wider coverage.
patterns.forbidden: Conceding a limit the work actually exceeded.
